CustomField.description: How often the map re-checks which villas are still free, in seconds. Zero switches the background poll off and leaves only the refreshes triggered by loading the map, returning to the tab and opening a villa. This is the lever to pull if the org is under strain on launch day. Anything between one and nine is treated as ten. Must also be added to the SELECT in ADHA_JourneyController.settings() or it reads as null.
CustomField.label: Availability Poll Seconds
